findings.summary: previous_defs now stores Line objects rather than integer depths, but the check self.previous_defs[-1] was not updated; a Line is always truthy, so a depth-0 def followed by a depth-0 line ending in ':' (e.g. else:) gets 1 blank line instead of 2. Should use self.previous_defs[-1].depth.
The new branch forces before = 1 after any nested non-stub class, regardless of which line follows.
The test data file may not be parsed as intended by read_data: it has no '# flags:' header and its '# output' separator may not match the expected format.
